sentenceIntentions.text: An organization can apologize fluently while leaving the machinery that caused the harm intact.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Contrast fluent apology with unchanged harmful operation
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize institutional conscience as potentially performative

sentenceIntentions.text: Egregopathy investigates the gap between what an organization says is right and what it keeps doing.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the gap between moral language and behavior

sentenceIntentions.text: A hospital, a bank, and a platform coordinate many decisions that no single participant sees whole.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make distributed decisions concrete across three institutions
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See why no one participant experiences the whole

sentenceIntentions.text: The book asks how organizations can treat people as tools while still presenting themselves as caring and fair.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Show people becoming instruments under respectable self-description
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the human stakes beneath procedure

sentenceIntentions.text: Responsibility becomes harder to locate as decisions pass through separate roles, rules, and rewards.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Track responsibility across roles and incentives

sentenceIntentions.text: The proposed term names patterns people can inspect, without imagining a hidden mind inside an organization.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Keep the proposed term grounded in observable patterns

sentenceIntentions.text: An apology starts to sound different when the same harm has become part of ordinary procedure.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect the inquiry with routine institutional betrayal
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect analysis of how harm persists

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin with the institution seen from outside, and ask which harms its own story leaves out.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Ask which harms reach the organization's own account
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to examine what its apology leaves untouched
